Departmental Budget & Expense Approval Overview
Each department is allocated an annual operating budget reviewed quarterly by finance leadership. Expense approval thresholds are tiered: purchases under $500 can be approved by a team lead, purchases between $500 and $5,000 require director sign-off, and anything above $5,000 requires VP approval plus a purchase order.
Travel and entertainment expenses are tracked separately from the operating budget and are capped at 8% of departmental spend per quarter. Departments exceeding their quarterly allocation must submit a variance explanation to finance. Budget overages are not automatically carried forward to the next quarter.
This document governs company financial controls and is maintained by the Finance team, not the People/HR team.
